issues.jp_before: 今日[きょう]{は/が|wa-topic}いい天気[てんき]です{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: が listed as alternative, but 今日が would mean 'today (of all days) is the nice one', not the given English

issues.jp_before: この花[はな]{は|wa-topic}きれいです{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: near-duplicate of the cherry-blossom, stars and view きれいですね items
issues.action: rewritten as この店は安くていいですね

issues.jp_before: 今日[きょう]{は|wa-topic}寒[さむ]いです{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: near-duplicate of the hot-today / nice-weather / windy-today items
issues.action: rewritten as 田中さんの子どもは大きくなりましたね (past change of state)

issues.jp_before: 今日[きょう]{は|wa-topic}疲[つか]れました{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: English 'We're tired today, aren't we?' is unnatural for 疲れましたね
issues.action: English changed to 'Today was tiring, wasn't it?'

issues.jp_before: このお茶[ちゃ]{は|wa-topic}熱[あつ]いです{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: near-duplicate pattern (このXはYですね, food/drink); batch lacks a direct remark to the listener
issues.action: rewritten as 鈴木さん、今日は早いですね

issues.jp_before: ここ{から|kara-from}{の|no-possessive}景色[けしき]{は|wa-topic}きれいです{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: からの split into two slots and の mislabelled no-possessive; catalog has no-compound for からの before a noun
issues.action: merged into one slot {からの|no-compound}; focus index changed 3 to 2

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{の|no-possessive}話[はなし]{は|wa-topic}わかりやすいです{ね|ne-agreement}。
この犬[いぬ]{は|wa-topic}かわいいです{ね|ne-agreement}。
issues.problem: near-duplicate of このくつはかわいいですね
issues.action: rewritten as 駅までけっこう遠かったですね

issues.jp_before: 田中[たなか]さん{が|ga-subject}呼[よ]びました{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: past 呼びました does not match 'was calling you'; the natural alert is 呼んでいますよ
issues.action: changed to 呼んでいますよ, English 'is calling for you'

issues.jp_before: この道[みち]{は|wa-topic}駅[えき]{に/へ|ni-destination}行[い]きます{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: 道が駅に行きます is unnatural for 'this road goes to the station'
issues.action: subject changed to このバス, English and why updated

issues.jp_before: 財布[さいふ]{が|ga-subject}落[お]ちました{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: English 'Your wallet fell, you know!' unnatural
issues.action: English changed to 'You've dropped your wallet!'

issues.jp_before: あの角[かど]{に|ni-location}コンビニ{が|ga-existence}あります{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: third near-identical 'there is an X at Y, you know' existence item
issues.action: rewritten as 窓が開いていますよ

issues.jp_before: この魚[さかな]{は|wa-topic}とても新[あたら]しいです{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: lv 4 implausible: all vocabulary is N5

issues.jp_before: ほら、空[そら]{が|ga-subject}きれいです{よ|yo-assertion}。
issues.problem: English 'Look, the sky is beautiful, you know!' is unnatural
issues.action: English changed to 'Hey, look up: the sky is beautiful!'; why mentions ほら
